hero.headline: COP31 climate talks deadlocked past deadline
hero.summary: Talks passed Friday's close after draft 2 omitted fossil-fuel phase-out text; France, the EU and Panama push back as a third draft is awaited.

hero.headline: Five Houthi missiles downed over Saudi Arabia
hero.summary: The Saudi-led coalition says air defenses destroyed three ballistic missiles over Riyadh and two over Jizan early Saturday after alerts woke residents.

hero.headline: M6.8 quake strikes Banda Sea off Timor-Leste
hero.summary: Deep tremor hit 103 km NE of Lospalos and shook Darwin, Australia; USGS and regional authorities reported no tsunami threat or deaths.

cards.headline: Deep M6.7 quake shakes central Peru
cards.summary: Andean tremor (108 km deep) sent Lima residents into streets; no deaths.

cards.headline: Zelenskyy calls Putin 'killer'; 52 hurt
cards.summary: Rebukes Trump remark as double-tap strike kills child and medic.

cards.headline: Iran says it downed US MQ-9 drone
cards.summary: IRGC claims new air defense hit Reaper; no US confirmation.

cards.headline: Nations aim for 'killer robot' rules
cards.summary: UN delegates agree to draft autonomous-weapon rules by 2028.

cards.headline: Air Niugini 767 lands after fire alert
cards.summary: HK–PNG flight diverts past midnight; all 146 evacuate unhurt.

cards.headline: Bitcoin hits 2-yr low; $2.4B wiped
cards.summary: BTC drops below $57k ($55.8k low) in AI rout; ether falls 5.4%.

cards.headline: Rahul's 136 puts India 118 ahead
cards.summary: First Indian opener with tons in all 4 SENA nations; Gill hits 98.

cards.headline: Verstappen takes Las Vegas F1 pole
cards.summary: Antonelli fastest but takes 5-place engine penalty; race tonight.
